info.title: WeKnora Nextcloud integration API
info.description: Routed contract for both pinned WeKnora patch baselines. Machine receipt, dispatch and application are distinct. Administrator controls require an interactive tenant Admin session; API keys are denied. Failed-candidate lists omit exact generation selectors, which the per-file status route returns.

X-WeKnora-Status-Signature.description: HMAC over the exact response and request signature

NextcloudHMAC.name: X-Nextcloud-Signature
NextcloudHMAC.description: Connection-scoped HMAC also requires X-Nextcloud-Connection-Id, X-Nextcloud-Key-Id, X-Nextcloud-Timestamp and X-Nextcloud-Nonce; canonical method, path, query and body hash are signed.

WebSession.description: Interactive web user; pair, connection and GC controls require tenant Admin.

EventReceipt.description: A durable inbox receipt is not an applied or publication acknowledgement.

FileStatus.description: Signed exact-ETag publication status; not a human retrieval grant.

SourceHealth.description: Database observations, not proof of per-file publication.

FailedCandidateItem.description: No document content or generation selectors.

EventConnectionStatus.description: Secret is not returned on status reads.

EventConnectionCredential.description: Secret is returned once by pair or rotation.
